items.label: Review existing Project Control glossary scope before creating product terminology.

items.verificationNote: Reviewed docs/GLOSSARY.md, docs/GLOSSARY_TH.md, data/documents/glossary-en.json, data/documents/glossary-th.json, and data/nodes/flowdoc.json before editing; existing glossary authority remains Project Control records and read-only GUI terminology.

items.label: Define product terms that split Project Control, Core, Backend, Editor, and frontend meanings.

items.label: Add terminology discipline to FlowDoc agent rules before product/frontend work.

items.label: Register documents, Work, Phase, Checklist, node links, and evidence without product truth promotion.

items.label: Run focused and full Project Control gates in the worktree and merged main.
items.evidenceTarget: Product terminology focused test, generated index check, semantic check, and full Project Control gate pass in the worktree and after merge to main.
